note: Three-column table of the six Ritus. Surya emitted the columns out of order. Read by eye. Note the book prints '(Autumn)' against BOTH Sarat and Hemanta; Hemanta is usually given as early winter. Preserved exactly as printed and flagged, not corrected.
markdown:
*Notes:* The Ritus (seasons) are six. Each is made up of two months thus:

| Ritu | Months | Season |
|---|---|---|
| Vasanta | Chaitra, Vaisakha | (Spring) |
| Grishma | Jyeshtha, Ashadha | (Summer) |
| Varsha | Sravana, Bhadrapada | (Rains) |
| Sarat | Asvina, Kartika | (Autumn) |
| Hemanta | Margasira, Pushya | (Autumn) |
| Sishira | Magha, Phalguna | (Winter) |
